REGULAR MEETING
OF THE
CITY COUNCIL AND
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - AUGUST 25, 2005 - CITY HALL -
3:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.

8.
Minutes of 8/11/05
End of Consent Calendar
9.
Public Hearings
9A.
A resolution of the City Council of the City of Cerritos finding the City to be in conformance with the Congestion Management Program (CMP) and adopting the CMP Local Development Report in accordance with California Government Code Section 65089
9B.
Cerritos Redevelopment Agency Conformity Report 2005-9/Negative Declaration/Conditional Use Permit 2005-3, Salim Lakhani/Al-Ilm Educational Academy/9626 Flower, LLC, 19446 Norwalk Boulevard, Cerritos, APN 7054-011-035
9C.
Consideration of a request from Knology Broadband of California, Inc. to transfer its Cerritos Cable Television Franchise to WaveDivision Holdings, LLC. A resolution of the City Council of the City of Cerritos approving the transfer of the Cable Television Franchise from Knology Broadband of California Inc. to Wave Broadband, LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of WaveDivision Holdings, LLC. An ordinance of the City Council of the City of Cerritos granting to Wave Broadband, LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of WaveDivision Holdings, LLC a non-exclusive franchise to construct, reconstruct, operate and maintain a cable system within the streets and public ways in the City of Cerritos and to offer to subscribers cable services utilizing the facilities of grantee’s cable system
10.
Pending Legal Matters – Ordinance/Resolution for consideration
10A.
An ordinance of the City Council of the City of Cerritos repealing Ordinance No. 636 and Ordinance No. 770, comprising Chapter 14.08 of the Cerritos Municipal Code, and replacing said chapter with a new chapter 14.08 providing for cable system regulation
10B.
A resolution of the City Council of the City of Cerritos declaring its intention to grant a franchise to Pacific Terminals, LLC (Delaware)
11.
Public Works Activities
11A.
Consideration of award of contract for the construction of the expansion of the Cerritos Senior Center at Pat Nixon Park, (APN 7054-017-901), Bid No. 1009-05, Project No. 72067
12.
New and Old Business
12A.
Consideration of a request of the American Association of University Women regarding its October 26, 2005 candidate forum.
12B.
Consideration of a request by Delta Environmental Consultants, Inc., 27141 Aliso Creek Road, Suite 270, Aliso Viejo, California for an extension of Temporary Use Permit 2005-3 allowing for a soil/water remediation system to be located at 12157 Artesia Boulevard (APN 7033-036-001)
12C.
Consideration by the Cerritos Redevelopment Agency of a lease agreement with the Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Authority (MTA) for property located west of Studebaker Road, south of Artesia Boulevard and east of the 605 freeway within the Los Cerritos Redevelopment Project Area (APN 7034-016-907)

14.
